accepted.altText: Beli fotokarton B2, 300 g/m² — celoten pogled na list. Prodaja po listih; dodatni prikazani listi niso vključeni.
accepted.sourceIdentityEvidence: Original ATEHNA and canonical MAT-PAP-FOT-BELA explicitly specify ordinary bela,300g/m² Fotokarton,B2. Source page independently specifies weiß,300g/m²,Fotokarton,DIN B2(ca50×70cm). This is a narrow commodity stock match by material, grammage, ordinary colour and named format; no Folia manufacturer assertion is added to ATEHNA stock and no textured-white or other colour variant is covered. Original ATEHNA title/description specify B2 only, without a measured millimetre size. The import script tmp/catalog-import/research-audit.mjs:5,11-14 explicitly converted B2 through formats.B2=[500,707]; canonical707 is an algorithmic nominal ISO normalization, not a measured source claim. Current storefront does display707×500mm. Both Kurth supplier pages explicitly call this stock DIN B2 (ca.50×70cm), also listing50×70cm. Accepted on matching original named DIN B2 commodity format; do not claim the photographed sheet was measured707mm. Existing canonical dimensions and all customer specifications are unchanged; nominal/trade distinction is recorded for root report.
